sources.title: aisingapore/Qwen-SEA-LION-v4-8B-VL · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Qwen-SEA-LION-v4-8B-VL is a 8-billion parameter Vision-Language Model (VLM) built upon the Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct architecture. To ensure domain adaptation for the region, the model underwent rigorous supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on a curated dataset of approximately 9 million instruction-text pairs.
